(NASDAQ:MU) has declined 19.44% since January 31, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.44% the S&P500.

It also increased its holding in Abbvie Inc (NYSE:ABBV) by 48,424 shares in the quarter, for a total of 541,245 shares, and has risen its stake in Pepsico Inc (NYSE:PEP).
